what_this_is: Every paid acquisition attempt this project has ever made, keyed on the page that was fetched rather than on the name the census gave the building. A cost plan consults it before a property may enter a paid cohort, so a re-census, a rename, a twin row or a later work order cannot buy an answer we already own.

provenance.completeness: POINT-IN-TIME, and partial by construction. Four of the six markets' artifacts live on branches that are not merged into this one, so this document is a snapshot of what those branches held at the commits named above. It is EVIDENCE, not authority: a market regenerates its own ledger at factory time from its own committed artifacts.
provenance.milwaukee_is_a_floor: milwaukee-wi predates ptf-market-paid-acquisition/1.0 and has no per-attempt document. Its rows are recovered from a proposals document that records one row per SUCCESSFUL read, so its failures and its retries are invisible here. Every milwaukee-wi figure is a lower bound.
